world_items.name: Guitar
world_items.full_description: The acoustic guitar is old with a pick stuck underneath the top fret.

world_items.name: Cat Tree
world_items.full_description: A beautiful tall cat tree,  Perfect to look out the window over the neon glow of the city.

world_items.name: Umbrella Stand
world_items.short_description: A narrow stand beside the entrance.
world_items.full_description: A few plain umbrellas rest in the stand. Water has collected in its removable tray.

world_items.name: Folded Receipt
world_items.short_description: A folded receipt on the ground.
world_items.full_description: The paper has been folded into a small square. Its faded printing is no longer readable.

world_items.name: Entrance Planter
world_items.short_description: A broad planter beside the entrance.
world_items.full_description: Closely trimmed foliage fills the planter. Its smooth rim is interrupted by a few shallow scratches.

world_items.name: Paper Cup
world_items.short_description: An empty paper cup near the doorway.
world_items.full_description: The cup is empty and dry. A small crescent has been pressed into its rolled rim.

world_items.name: Scuffed Bench
world_items.short_description: A bench with a worn seat.
world_items.full_description: The middle of the seat has been rubbed smooth. Dust remains along the seam beneath its backrest.

world_items.name: Rubber Band
world_items.short_description: A rubber band beside the bench.
world_items.full_description: A plain rubber band, slightly stretched and still springy.

world_items.name: Worn Doormat
world_items.short_description: A broad mat near the building entrance.
world_items.full_description: The center of the mat has flattened under many footsteps. Its curled corner catches dust.

world_items.name: Bottle Cap
world_items.short_description: A bottle cap caught along the edge of the mat.
world_items.full_description: The cap is dented on one side. Its printed surface has been scraped nearly blank.

world_items.name: Reception Desk
world_items.short_description: A smooth desk beneath the lobby lights.
world_items.full_description: The desktop is almost bare. A circular mark interrupts the polish where a cup has repeatedly been set down.

world_items.name: Lobby Seating
world_items.short_description: A row of neatly aligned seats.
world_items.full_description: Firm cushions sit in polished frames. One cushion has a shallow crease where someone has recently been sitting.

world_items.name: Tray Return
world_items.short_description: A rack holding a short stack of lunch trays.
world_items.full_description: The trays nest unevenly. Small scratches cross their broad plastic surfaces.

world_items.name: Paper Napkin
world_items.short_description: An unused napkin beside a table.
world_items.full_description: The napkin is folded in half, with one corner bent upward.

world_items.name: Waste Bin
world_items.short_description: A small bin against the hallway wall.
world_items.full_description: The bin has a brushed metal lid and a dark scuff close to its base.

world_items.name: Crinkled Wrapper
world_items.short_description: A small wrapper along the skirting board.
world_items.full_description: The empty wrapper crackles when disturbed. Its shiny inner surface catches the light.

world_items.name: Folded Blanket
world_items.short_description: A soft blanket folded into a resting place.
world_items.full_description: The blanket has been worked into a shallow hollow. Loose fibers cling to its edges.

world_items.name: Cardboard Box
world_items.short_description: A low cardboard box with folded flaps.
world_items.full_description: The box has softened at the corners. One flap carries a line of small tooth marks.
